title: Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price List and Package Inclusions (Good Faith & Price Estimates)
content:
Riverbend's self-pay package prices are all-inclusive prices per service code, published for the three package types of Good Faith & Price Estimates. The other four estimate types carry no package price: their charges are priced per line.

## Inclusions, exclusions and add-ons by estimate type

| Estimate type | Estimate limits what the patient may be billed | Riverbend Medical Group professional fees included | Items billed outside the package or estimate at actual charges | Upgrade differential within the package (USD) | Each additional overnight stay beyond the included stay (USD) | Overnight stays included |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Self-Pay Good Faith Estimate - Single Scheduled Service | no | no | services of unlisted providers | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Self-Pay Good Faith Estimate - Procedure with Co-Providers | no | no | services of unlisted providers | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Self-Pay Good Faith Estimate - Recurring Course of Care | no | no | services of unlisted providers | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate | no | no | services of unlisted providers; benefit changes after verification | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Imaging & Diagnostics | yes | yes | treatment of a contrast reaction; radiologist second read requested by the patient | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery | yes | yes | complications requiring admission; implants above standard; readmission within 30 days | 0.00 | 1650.00 | 0 |
| Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery | yes | yes | NICU care; newborn professional services; maternal ICU care | 2850.00 (cesarean delivery) | 1425.00 | 2 |

## Reading the schedule

- A code that is not on a package type's schedule has no package price under that type.
- The upgrade differential exists only on the Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery, where the upgrade is a cesarean delivery; every other type shows 0.00.
- Example (hypothetical): a maternity package patient who stays three nights has one night beyond the two included nights, so one additional overnight stay at 1425.00 applies.
